name: Create a return journey request
description: Verify a user can schedule and submit a return journey for a clinic visit.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the public demo flow in a fresh browser context
Open the sample family using the sample controls
Open the upcoming clinic visit details
Open the return journey creation flow
Fill in the responsibility field with a synthetic return ride plan
Select a valid date for the return journey
Select a valid time for the return journey
Fill in the practical details field with a synthetic note about confirming pickup details
Select a person to ask to drive
Verify the return journey is shown as created for the visit
Verify the named driver is associated with the return journey
